nodes.label: Complete IC panel with zero uncovered risk category?
nodes.description: Which disciplines constitute a complete IC panel such that no risk category is unowned?

nodes.label: Deal advocate kept independent of adversarial credit seat?
nodes.description: How is the deal advocate structurally separated from the scrutinizing credit seat?

nodes.label: Elicit genuine dissent, avoid sycophancy / correlated error?
nodes.description: How do we produce real disagreement and avoid rubber-stamping and same-model correlated error?

nodes.label: Live human-chaired deliberation on Claude Code primitives?
nodes.description: How is an interruptible human-chaired deliberation realized given subagents cannot pause for a human?

nodes.label: Expert objection -> atomic claim + severity axis?
nodes.description: How does an expert objection map to an axiom-synthesis atomic claim plus a severity axis?

nodes.label: Verdict computed deterministically without fabricating consensus?
nodes.description: How is PROCEED/DECLINE computed mechanically, terminating in UNRESOLVED, never narrated?

nodes.label: Canonical IC-memo structure and Risk->Mitigant->Residual->CP pattern?
nodes.description: What is the memo canon and the bound risk triplet with conditions-precedent tagging?

nodes.label: Legal checks: deal-breaker vs curable; legal-analyst coverage?
nodes.description: Which legal/compliance checks are deal-breakers vs curable-by-condition and what does legal-analyst already cover?

nodes.label: Chair observes/injects; agents value input without capitulating?
nodes.description: How does the human chair inject input and how do agents update-with-fact or hold-with-reason?

nodes.label: Concentration (fund-scoped) and financial-statement fraud explicitly owned?
nodes.description: How are fund-level concentration and statement-fraud made someone's explicit mandate?

nodes.label: Guardrail for autopilot-active auto-answering the human pause?
nodes.description: What handles autopilot-active silently auto-answering the pause AskUserQuestion?

nodes.label: Deliberation state persisted; survives /clear and Eternity resume?
nodes.description: How is deliberation state persisted so it survives /clear and cross-session resume?

nodes.label: Credit & Cash-Flow seat
nodes.description: Adversarial credit seat; DSCR/LTV/debt-yield under stress; owns credit + cash-flow risk; folds exit sub-mandate.

nodes.label: Collateral Valuation seat
nodes.description: Appraisal methodology, comps, condition, zoning; valuation is a 3-discipline reconciliation.

nodes.label: Legal & Structural seat
nodes.description: Title/lien priority/SPE/loan-doc/intercreditor; delegates to legal-analyst; runs state sub-pass.

nodes.label: Environmental & Physical seat
nodes.description: Phase I/RECs, soils, property-condition/PCA and construction-completion sub-pass.

nodes.label: Insurance & Climate seat
nodes.description: Insurance adequacy + physical-climate merged; stresses renewal cost into pro forma (DSCR transmission).

nodes.label: Sponsor & Fraud-Forensics seat
nodes.description: Adversarial financial-statement veracity ('assume fabricated until externally corroborated'); sponsor/OFAC.

nodes.label: Portfolio & Concentration seat (fund-scoped)
nodes.description: NOT deal-scoped; reads the fund loan tape; owns sponsor/geo/property-type/lien/maturity concentration.

nodes.label: Chair / Gap-Hunter meta-seat
nodes.description: Procedural chair; hunts risks nobody claimed; ensures explicit verdicts; never silences dissent.

nodes.label: Deal Advocate / Underwriting Lead
nodes.description: Packages the ask; completeness gate; MUST NOT cast a scrutiny vote (narrative-capture avoidance).

nodes.label: acos-axiom-synthesis engine
nodes.description: Fixture-tested refutation-and-grading engine; decircularize/grade/fuse/falsify/resolve/lifecycle/coverage; UNRESOLVED terminal.

nodes.label: legal-analyst agent + /acos-legal-analysis
nodes.description: Mode-A lending diligence A1-A8; 5-tier severity; findings-manifest.yaml, red-flags.yaml.

nodes.label: IC memo (recommendation.md)
nodes.description: 13-section canon rendered from the ledger, never hand-edited; BLUF verdict box.

nodes.label: Append-only deliberation transcript
nodes.description: Per-turn JSON + human-readable render; source of truth; survives /clear + resume.

nodes.label: Fund loan tape / portfolio register
nodes.description: Fund-level exposure register the Portfolio seat reads; absent from any single deal folder.

nodes.label: conflicts-disclosure.yaml
nodes.description: Per-run governance artifact; each seat discloses conflicts before voting (SEC 2026 focus).

nodes.label: Independence-first blind opening pass
nodes.description: Every seat's opening verdict from an isolated Task() with zero cross-visibility; cross-talk only R2+.

nodes.label: Mode A: fan-out then synthesize
nodes.description: Blind seats fan out; axiom-synthesis fuses; renders memo + deterministic verdict. Cheaper default.

nodes.label: Mode B: moderated relay
nodes.description: Main-conversation moderator; blind openings then bounded rebuttal rounds; HITL pauses; transcript-on-disk.

nodes.label: Deterministic verdict computation
nodes.description: resolve.py over per-discipline roll-ups; asymmetric-veto on deal-breakers; UNRESOLVED terminal; never narrated.

nodes.label: Falsification / cross-examination gate
nodes.description: Independent different-discipline refuter attempts to rebut each claim; ACH; nullification; oscillation guard.

nodes.label: Legal delegation + compliance companion
nodes.description: Dispatch legal-analyst (A1-A8); companion covers usury/licensing, AML/KYC/OFAC, foreclosure mechanics, Phase I currency.

nodes.label: Autopilot-active detection + safe fallback
nodes.description: Detect .acos/state/autopilot-active; refuse deep-pause or fall back to documented batch mode; safe (Recommended) option.

nodes.label: Pre-mortem / inversion
nodes.description: Frame total failure as already-happened, reasons written independently and silently first, then round-robin.

nodes.label: Mediating Assessments Protocol (MAP)
nodes.description: Decompose into fixed independent dimensions; estimate-talk-estimate; delay holistic verdict until all dimensions scored.

nodes.label: Analysis of Competing Hypotheses (ACH)
nodes.description: Matrix hypotheses x evidence; seek disconfirming evidence; each seat generates >=1 competing failure hypothesis.

nodes.label: Reference-class forecasting
nodes.description: Pull empirical base-rate (default rate, LGD, time-to-resolution) and reconcile sponsor projections against it.

nodes.label: Pre-committed kill criteria
nodes.description: Disqualifiers decided before the deal is in the room; applied mechanically FIRST; override = logged policy exception.

nodes.label: Blind independent first pass
nodes.description: Isolated parallel first verdicts; the single highest-leverage anti-groupthink lever; proven ACOS pattern.

nodes.label: Asymmetric-veto resolution
nodes.description: Verdict polarity where a single dissent blocks on deal-breaker-flagged claims (false-accept is catastrophic).

nodes.label: Assigned rotating devil's advocate + 10th-man
nodes.description: Assigned (not volunteered) contrarian producing a quantified downside; consensus-triggered 10th-man escalation.

nodes.label: Justification-forcing (update-or-hold)
nodes.description: No stance change without naming the new fact; only '(UPDATED) new fact' or 'HOLDING: why unchanged'; flips audited.

nodes.label: Model-class / persona diversity
nodes.description: Opus vs Sonnet + persona/temperature (cross-family when available) to cut correlated same-model error.

nodes.label: Axis S (severity/materiality) extension
nodes.description: Domain-owned ordinal ladder informational<limitation<material-risk<deal-breaker-candidate; stored alongside A/B, never blended.

nodes.label: OCC Comptroller's Handbook (CRE Lending)
nodes.description: Independent loan review separate from originators; concentration assessed at portfolio level.

nodes.label: FDIC RMS Manual §3.2
nodes.description: CRE risk domains; recurring failure = policy exceptions without documented compensating factors.

nodes.label: FinCEN CRE Financing Fraud advisory
nodes.description: False docs, inflated appraisals, undisclosed side agreements, non-disclosure; often undiscovered until after closing.

nodes.label: ASTM E1527-21 (Phase I ESA)
nodes.description: Mandatory since 2024-02-13; E1527-13 no longer qualifies; currency/staleness gate for BFPP defenses.

nodes.label: CERCLA §101(20) secured-lender exemption
nodes.description: Conditional and time-boxed lender liability protection; innocent-landowner/BFPP require conforming Phase I.

nodes.label: SEC 2026 exam priorities (private-credit fiduciary)
nodes.description: Conflicts disclosure, independently-supportable valuation, retained minutes/reasoning as evidential exercise.

nodes.label: Utah Commercial Financing Registration (2023)
nodes.description: Registration with Utah DFI for >5 commercial transactions/yr; exemptions incl. >$1M / depositories.

nodes.label: Three Lines of Defense / independence principle
nodes.description: Origination vs risk/compliance vs internal audit; approving to preserve a relationship is a red flag.

nodes.label: CQ coverage %
nodes.description: Fraction of competency questions with a lattice path to methods + metrics/standards; target >=95%.

nodes.label: Risk-category coverage (zero uncovered)
nodes.description: Every one of the 16 risk categories has a named owning seat; validated against the coverage map.

nodes.label: DSCR / debt yield
nodes.description: Debt-service-coverage and debt-yield under stress; core credit metric owned by the Credit seat.

nodes.label: Axis S severity ladder
nodes.description: Ordinal materiality grade per finding: informational/limitation/material-risk/deal-breaker-candidate.

nodes.label: Reduced-independence flag
nodes.description: Boolean emitted when all seats share one provider (role-diversity only) -> labeled, not blocked.

nodes.label: Fund-level concentration risk
nodes.description: Invisible to any deal-scoped review; silent PASS unless a fund-scoped seat with loan-tape access owns it.

nodes.label: Financial-statement / valuation fraud
nodes.description: Most-repeated deal killer; by default nobody's job (Credit trusts T-12, Valuation trusts NOI, Legal never opens the sheet).

nodes.label: autopilot-active silent auto-answer
nodes.description: autopilot-askuserquestion-handler auto-picks the (Recommended) option -> the human pause never reaches a human.

nodes.label: Refinance / exit / maturity risk
nodes.description: Under-weighted vs day-one collateral; for a bridge-heavy book, maturity default can exceed collateral shortfall.

nodes.label: Insurance-cost / physical-climate risk
nodes.description: Non-renewal/premium spikes break DSCR -> forced refi/sale; insurance is now a live underwriting variable.

nodes.label: Reuse over rebuild
nodes.description: IC skill is a thin orchestrator + domain adapter over axiom-synthesis + legal-analyst + Wigum/consensus/blind-dispatch.

nodes.label: Transcript-as-source-of-truth
nodes.description: Every turn hits disk immediately (dr2/fin-stmt discipline); enables /clear + crash + Eternity resume.

nodes.label: Main-conversation-is-moderator
nodes.description: Only the top-level SKILL.md can call AskUserQuestion; no nested agent owns the human-pausing loop.

nodes.label: Risk -> Mitigant -> Residual triplet + CP
nodes.description: Bound triplet, never a bare list; mitigant caps not erases; residual mandatory; each CP tagged to the risk it retires.

nodes.label: Consensus-as-correctness
nodes.description: Terminating on 'all agents agree'; debate induces a martingale and cannot exceed the strongest participant.

nodes.label: Sycophancy / rubber-stamping
nodes.description: ~58% baseline agreement; 63.7% agreement with an asserted incorrect belief; self-reported confidence counted as evidence.

nodes.label: Correlated same-model ensemble
nodes.description: N copies of one model share errors (0.679 vs 0.396 cross-family); 10 same-model agents ~ 1.4 independent forecasters.

nodes.label: LLM-narrated verdict
nodes.description: A synthesizer LLM narrating PROCEED/DECLINE; verdict must be computed deterministically from the ledger.

nodes.label: Silent concentration/fraud pass
nodes.description: N agents each read only the deal folder -> concentration + statement veracity get a zero-effort silent PASS.

nodes.label: LLM-aggregator blend (MoA)
nodes.description: An aggregator LLM blends/arbitrates away disagreement; route same-fact conflicts through resolve_conflict() instead.

nodes.label: Deal-breaker (derived rule)
nodes.description: state in {ESTABLISHED,CORROBORATED} AND axis_s>=material-risk AND no surviving mitigant claim.

nodes.label: Mitigant
nodes.description: Structural/documentary control (reserve, guaranty, covenant, insurance, CP, holdback) that caps a risk, not aspirational.

nodes.label: Residual risk
nodes.description: What remains true after the mitigant; mandatory even on approved deals; mitigant caps rarely eliminates.

nodes.label: Conditions Precedent (CP)
nodes.description: Binding pre-funding gate that converts a risk into an approvable deal; each tagged to the risk ID it retires.

nodes.label: UNRESOLVED (first-class verdict)
nodes.description: Terminal state when no rung decides; never a fabricated PROCEED/DECLINE; preserves dissent.
